observation.command:
cd /workspace/app && nohup pnpm nx serve app --configuration=instance --port=34237 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=app.workspace.localhost > /tmp/app-direct2.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"; sleep 150; grep -aE "Local:.*34237|bundle generation" /tmp/app-direct2.log | tail -2; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 http://127.0.0.1:34237/ 2>&1); echo "127.0.0.1:34237 -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}"
